discovery.title: Mechanical shortcut' rapidly carries organic particles into the deep ocean
discovery.summary: The processes that capture carbon from the atmosphere and store it on the seabed are crucial for climate balance. However, assessing these mechanisms is often complicated because it requires measurements ranging from the surface to the deep ocean.
